{"notes": "Visit 4 (left 9:45). Only observation: at 9:15 Priya told everyone 'Under a minute, everyone. Hands off and enjoy the fall!' Picture: whole fish still dark/connected, nose at start, both body arcs, crossing near (23,10), both tails intact (upper to ~27.5,4.5; lower to ~27,15.5). Nothing pale or stranded. Lower tail still bunched (~25.5-27, 13-15) but standing; the likeliest weak point for the push. No hand labels visible. Team result looks strong, but that credit is shared, not individual.

Maya: No new observation. Earlier she volunteered nudging a domino near the lower tail and it was intact: good honesty and ownership. Still don't know what she built.

Leo: No new observation. Earlier set and repeated a clear stop-touching rule; his connectivity claim held up. Good process and leadership. Still need his own build contribution.

Priya: Called the countdown and reinforced hands-off, keeping the team calm and on timing. Earlier said the back line looks solid. Some collaboration/leadership signal, but still no evidence of what she built, so impact and execution are unclear.

Tom: Absent from view and silent for four visits. No evidence either way. Don't assume he did nothing; don't rate until I ask him directly.

Next: before the review, ask each person privately what they built and who did what, Tom first. Hold ratings until I have more than the shared picture, since I can't tell who placed which domino."}
